title: Multi-Channel Notification Fanout (Email, SMS, Push)
learningObjectives: Design unified notification schemas with provider-specific adapter templates
Implement fallback routing across external gateways (e.g. Twilio, SendGrid, FCM)
Track delivery states (sent, delivered, opened, bounced) through webhooks
keyTradeoffs: Immediate delivery cascade vs batching notification digests
In-house template rendering vs third-party notification platforms
commonPitfalls: Blocking user-facing requests on external SMTP/SMS network calls
Failing to handle hard bounces and spam complaints, leading to IP reputation burn
transferPrompt: How does notification fanout check customer preference rules and quiet hours before sending messages?
